value.name: Asha ignores phone vibration
value.description: Asha notices her phone vibrate but chooses not to answer it while continuing the client conversation.
evidence: Asha's phone, face-down beside the folder, vibrated once against the wood, and she did not turn it over

value.name: Asha asks for the account again
value.description: Asha asks Mrs. Hatcher to repeat the account from the corner of Twelfth.
evidence: only nodded at Mrs. Hatcher and asked her to walk through it one more time from the corner of Twelfth

value.name: Mrs. Hatcher repeats her account
value.description: Mrs. Hatcher restarts her story from the corner of Twelfth, speaking more steadily after repeating it several times.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher started again from the corner of Twelfth, her voice steadier now that she had said the time three times in a row

value.name: Asha reads Rosa's message
value.description: Asha turns her phone face-up and reads Rosa's second message saying the Tuesday gap is hers.
evidence: she slid two fingers under the edge of her phone and turned it face-up on the wood. The screen showed Rosa's second message under the first: the Tuesday gap is yours. Asha read it once

value.name: Asha conceals her reaction
value.description: Asha keeps her attention on Mrs. Hatcher and hides any reaction to Rosa's message by setting the phone face-down again.
evidence: kept her eyes on Mrs. Hatcher rather than on the words, and set the phone back face-down beside the folder without any change in her expression

value.name: Client continues discussing pickup window
value.description: Mrs. Hatcher continues talking about the school-pickup window while Asha remains outwardly composed.
evidence: so that the client across the table registered only a small movement of her wrist and went on with the school-pickup window

value.name: Asha marks Tuesday decision internally
value.description: Asha's unresolved decision about whether to raise the Tuesday issue in the hearing settles more firmly into her mind.
evidence: the decision about whether to be the one to name the Tuesday line in the hearing settled a little further into the side of the folder where she had already put it

value.name: Asha ends the review and stands
value.description: After Mrs. Hatcher finishes repeating the account, Asha closes her legal pad and rises from the table.
evidence: Asha let Mrs. Hatcher finish the walk from the corner of Twelfth one final time, then closed the legal pad over the two forty-eight written in her small even hand and stood.

value.name: Asha gathers her materials to leave
value.description: Asha picks up the folder containing the Tuesday report and takes her coat from the chair, preparing to leave the room.
evidence: She picked up the folder with the Tuesday report still face-down at the bottom, gathered her coat from the back of the chair
